requirement: A replacement entry with `pinned: true` must create a pinned successor.

inputs.contents:
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Entry {
    #[serde(deserialize_with = "required_value")]
    pub content: Value,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub pinned: bool,
    pub review: Option<Review>,
}
